 Move the blog to plain files
 Project <id> · active
 ○3 open · ✓1 done
 Created: <date>

 Description

 Why move

 The current CMS needs a database, a PHP upgrade every year and a plugin audit after each one.
 Nothing on the blog changes after it is published, so none of that earns its keep.

 ▌ Done means

 • Every old URL still answers, through a permanent redirect where it moved.
 • A post goes live by merging a markdown file.
 • The old server is shut down and its dump is stored somewhere boring.
